annotation.title_clean: El Consejo Económico y Social impulsa la creación de un centro para la promoción de Inteligencia Artificial en la Argentina
annotation.title_en: The Economic and Social Council promotes the creation of a centre for the promotion of Artificial Intelligence in Argentina
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Presidencia de la Nación, Jefatura de Gabinete de Ministros, Secretaría de Asuntos Estratégicos
annotation.summary_en: Argentine government news item on a 5 April 2022 forum held by the Economic and Social Council announcing Argentina's adhesion to the Global Partnership on AI and a proposed Multidisciplinary AI Centre (CamIA) centred at UBA to foster talent and public-private collaboration. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Argentina announced adhesion to the Global Partnership on AI (France/Canada-led).
Proposal to create the Multidisciplinary AI Centre (CamIA), hub at University of Buenos Aires.
Forum with seven panels and 30 experts on AI, productive sector and regulation.
Emphasis on ethical, responsible AI for the common good and productivity.
